scope.en: Targeted review of the existing database plus public framework issues, not an exhaustive unresolved-issue list. Upstream observations use rendered primary pages, some cached. Visible issue activity and targeted PR searches do not establish repository-wide absence of a fix.
scope.zh-CN: 从现有数据库与公开 framework issue 定向筛选，不代表全部未解决问题。上游核验依据返回的主页面，部分为缓存；可见活动与定向 PR 搜索不等于已穷尽仓库中的修复。

criteria.en: Primary candidates must have an unresolved causal question and no demonstrated fix for that exact failure in the inspected material. An existing patch, including an unmerged patch, removes an item from the first-root-cause queue. Timeouts, restarts and untested suggestions are not causal repairs. All proposed CoroPerf gains remain unverified.
criteria.zh-CN: 首要候选须仍有未解决的因果问题，且所读材料未展示针对该失败的有效修复。已有补丁（包括未合并补丁）退出首次根因发现队列；超时、重启和未测试建议不算根因修复。所有 CoroPerf 新增诊断收益均待验证。

workflow.en: Review one issue at a time: confirm status and original inputs; reproduce with ordinary diagnostics; identify the missing identity/history relation; collect the necessary evidence; test competing causes; validate a repair against the original regression.
workflow.zh-CN: 逐个过：确认状态与原始输入；用普通诊断复现；明确缺失的身份／历史关系；采集所需证据；区分竞争解释；用原回归测试验证修复。

question.en: Which execution stops making progress before the sample_tokens RPC times out?
question.zh-CN: sample_tokens RPC 超时之前，哪段执行首先停止进展？

known.en: Workers become unresponsive without an exception. A recent report still describes silent stalls on 0.33.0; the discussion contains distinct failure modes that must be separated.
known.zh-CN: worker 无异常地失去响应；最近的 0.33.0 报告仍有静默停顿，讨论中混有不同失败模式，需要分开处理。

patch.en: Upstream describes #58779 as bounding the wait, not eliminating the stall. Disabling adaptive verification is a suggested diagnostic direction, not a confirmed fix for the selected failure. No causal repair was identified in the inspected discussion and targeted PR search.
patch.zh-CN: 上游说明 #58779 限制等待时间，但没有消除底层停顿。禁用 adaptive verification 是待检验方向，不是所选失败的已确认修复。本轮讨论与定向 PR 搜索未发现针对该停顿的已验证修复。

coroperf_addition.en: Connect initiating request and batch histories to the specific RPC, worker generation and rank; identify the earliest missing progress event.
coroperf_addition.zh-CN: 把发起请求、batch 历史接到具体 RPC、worker 代次与 rank，定位最早缺失的进展事件。

required_evidence.en: Request/batch/RPC identities; process and rank generations; native worker stacks; device-event or collective progress; ordered dispatch and completion. These bridges need implementation and validation.
required_evidence.zh-CN: request／batch／RPC 身份、进程和 rank 代次、原生 worker 栈、设备事件或 collective 进展、派发与完成次序；这些关联仍需实现和验证。

validation.en: Select one silent-worker report and preserve its exact build, model and load. Compare healthy and stalled runs before a cause-specific repair; separate other exception and timeout-only cases.
validation.zh-CN: 选定一条静默 worker 报告，保留精确构建、模型与负载；比较正常／停顿轨迹，再验证针对原因的修复，分开处理异常退出与仅超时的其他子案例。

limits.en: Requires the selected multi-GPU/model environment. Coroutine ancestry alone cannot prove a CUDA or collective deadlock; no local reproduction, overhead or repair result is available.
limits.zh-CN: 需要所选报告对应的多 GPU／模型环境；协程祖先本身不能证明 CUDA 或 collective 死锁，目前没有本地复现、开销或修复结果。

first_step.en: Recover one reporter configuration, workload inputs and native traces; establish that the same silent stall still reproduces.
first_step.zh-CN: 先取得一位报告者的配置、负载输入与原生轨迹，确认同一种静默停顿仍可复现。

question.en: Which rank or transfer initiates the decode-wide stall?
question.zh-CN: 哪个 rank 或传输首先引发 decode 侧整体停顿？

known.en: A November 26 report records multiple decode DP ranks losing progress together, followed by device-event synchronization timeout. Prefill remains healthy.
known.zh-CN: 11 月 26 日报告记录 decode 侧多个 DP rank 同时失去进展，随后设备事件同步超时，而 prefill 侧仍正常。

patch.en: The inspected primary page remains in Backlog with no repair proposal or linked development change visible. Targeted PR search found no matching fix; this does not establish repository-wide absence.
patch.zh-CN: 所读主页面仍为 Backlog，可见活动未出现修复方案或关联开发改动；定向 PR 搜索未发现匹配修复，不代表已穷尽整个仓库。

coroperf_addition.en: Join request/transfer histories to worker and rank generations and device completion events to separate the first blocked operation from cascading waits.
coroperf_addition.zh-CN: 将请求／传输历史接到 worker 与 rank 代次和设备完成事件，区分最初阻塞的操作与后续连锁等待。

required_evidence.en: Decode request, KV transfer and batch identities; process/rank generations; synchronization and device completion; cross-process timing. Actual work units must not be assumed to be coroutines.
required_evidence.zh-CN: decode 请求、KV transfer 与 batch 身份，进程／rank 代次，同步与设备完成事件，跨进程时间；不能假定所有工作单元都是协程。

validation.en: Retain the reported deployment and compare recoverable versus persistent stalls. Establish the first missing completion before designing and validating a causal repair.
validation.zh-CN: 保留所报部署，对比可自行恢复与持续停顿的轨迹；先查明第一个缺失完成事件，再设计并验证针对原因的修复。

limits.en: The original setup is a multi-node Ascend A3 deployment. Required NPU observations and reproduction access are unestablished; there is no local runtime result.
limits.zh-CN: 原配置为多节点 Ascend A3 部署；尚未建立所需 NPU 观察与复现环境，没有本地运行结果。

first_step.en: Obtain the original workload and per-rank traces, and confirm access to a matching Ascend deployment.
first_step.zh-CN: 先取得原负载与逐 rank 轨迹，并确认可使用匹配的 Ascend 部署。

question.en: Which event stops the last socket-write operation from completing?
question.zh-CN: 最后一次 socket write 为什么不再完成？

known.en: A closed-peer writer hangs. A later upstream comment reports the same failure with callbacks and improvement with epoll disabled; handler and frame-lifetime traces already exist. These are partial results, not a confirmed root cause.
known.zh-CN: 对端关闭后，写协程停住。上游评论报告回调版本也失败、禁用 epoll 后恢复，并已有 handler 与 frame 生命周期轨迹；这些是阶段性证据，尚未确证根因。

patch.en: No repair PR is shown in the rendered Development section. A related issue and attached reproducers are not a verified patch.
patch.zh-CN: 所读页面的 Development 未列修复 PR；相关 issue 与复现附件不等于已验证补丁。

coroperf_addition.en: Join the writer and reused child-frame generations to the specific write operation, then locate the first missing registration, readiness, completion or resume event.
coroperf_addition.zh-CN: 把 writer、复用的子 frame 代次与具体 write 操作关联，定位注册、就绪、完成、恢复链中第一个缺失的事件。

required_evidence.en: Frame generation; socket generation; operation/handler identity; epoll registration and readiness; completion, resume and cleanup order. Operation/reactor observers are additional work.
required_evidence.zh-CN: frame 代次、socket 代次、operation／handler 身份、epoll 注册与就绪，以及完成／恢复／清理顺序；操作与 reactor 观察点仍需补齐。

validation.en: Use one pinned affected build for the original, callback and backend controls. Check whether the pending operation remains queued or completed without a resume. Validate any eventual repair against the unchanged regression and success/error paths.
validation.zh-CN: 固定受影响构建，比较原例、回调与后端对照；核对操作仍在队列，还是已完成却未恢复。若找到修复，用未改动的回归测试及正常／错误路径验证。

limits.en: Creation ancestry alone cannot explain lost reactor progress; callback failure argues against a coroutine-only cause. The original fixture/timeout and exact dependencies still need recovery.
limits.zh-CN: 仅创建祖先不能解释 reactor 丢失进展；回调同样失败，不能预设是协程缺陷。原 fixture／超时与匹配依赖仍需取得。

first_step.en: Recover the original fixture and pin Boost 1.88.0 / GCC 13.3 / Ubuntu 24.04 before collecting anything.
first_step.zh-CN: 先取得原 fixture，固定 Boost 1.88.0／GCC 13.3／Ubuntu 24.04，再开始采集。

question.en: Why does the subscription handshake stop in ConnectedEstablishing?
question.zh-CN: 订阅连接握手为何停在 ConnectedEstablishing？

known.en: One CI run stalled against a fake in-process replica. The issue explains why that state consumes the connect timeout, but leaves client versus test-server scheduling unresolved; repeated local attempts did not reproduce it.
known.zh-CN: 一次 CI 在进程内模拟 replica 上停住。报告已解释该状态为何耗尽连接超时，但客户端还是模拟服务端调度造成停顿尚未确定，多次本地尝试未复现。

patch.en: Two referenced commits change test discovery/setup; the report does not establish them as a repair of the stalled handshake. No repair PR is shown in Development.
patch.zh-CN: 两个引用提交涉及测试发现／准备，报告没有证明它们修复握手停顿；Development 未列修复 PR。

coroperf_addition.en: Connect handshake and response-processing Tasks to one connection generation and determine which pending response or continuation prevents completion.
coroperf_addition.zh-CN: 把握手、响应处理 Task 关联到同一连接代次，找出哪个未完成响应或 continuation 阻止结束。

required_evidence.en: Task tokens across resumes; interactive versus subscription connection identity; message/response and pipe ownership; fake-server dispatch; completion times.
required_evidence.zh-CN: 跨恢复的 Task token、interactive／subscription 连接身份、消息／响应及 pipe 所有权、模拟服务端派发和完成时间。

validation.en: Capture the original in-process test and compare successful and stalled connection generations. Locate the earliest missing response/dispatch; distinguish a fake-server fault from a client defect before a repair claim.
validation.zh-CN: 采集原进程内测试，对比正常与停住的连接代次，定位最早缺失的响应／派发，先区分模拟服务端与客户端问题，再谈修复。

limits.en: A real Redis replica is not an equivalent reproduction. Task creation does not establish message or pipe ownership; resource observers and the rare failing schedule are still needed.
limits.zh-CN: 真实 Redis replica 不能替代这个复现。Task 创建关系不证明消息或 pipe 所有权，仍需资源观察及原始失败时序。

first_step.en: Recover the exact CI revision, test and logs; preserve the pub/sub path that the later discovery test bypassed.
first_step.zh-CN: 先取得精确 CI revision、测试和日志，保留后来 discovery 测试绕开的 pub/sub 路径。

question.en: Which command or completion leaves the sequential database workflow waiting?
question.zh-CN: 哪条命令或完成事件让数据库顺序工作流一直等待？

known.en: The original report describes post-insert hangs; later reports discuss a growing queue. A 2026 maintainer comparison did not reproduce the original behavior. The page still requests a reproduction and investigation.
known.zh-CN: 原报告描述批量插入后的挂起，后续报告提到队列增长；维护者 2026 年的对照没有复现原症状，页面仍标记需要复现与调查。

patch.en: No repair PR is shown in Development. Bulk loading and transaction suggestions do not establish a repair for the original hang.
patch.zh-CN: Development 未列修复 PR；批量导入、事务等建议没有证明修复原始挂起。

coroperf_addition.en: Attribute queued/current commands to their initiating Promise resources and compare enqueue, dispatch and callback settlement.
coroperf_addition.zh-CN: 把排队／当前命令接回发起 Promise 资源，对照入队、派发、回调与 settlement 的缺口。

required_evidence.en: Async-resource identity; connection generation; command sequence; transaction ownership; socket progress and settlement. These resource relations need explicit observations.
required_evidence.zh-CN: async-resource 身份、连接代次、命令序号、事务所有权、socket 进展与 settlement；这些资源关系需要额外观察。

validation.en: First reproduce one pinned reporter workflow. Compare its stalled command history with a successful run and database activity, then test a cause-specific change without changing the submitted workload.
validation.zh-CN: 先复现一套固定的报告者工作流，比较挂起／正常运行的命令历史和数据库活动，再保持负载不变验证针对原因的改动。

limits.en: Several versions and reporter workloads are mixed in this long thread. The 2026 test is not a confirmed reproduction; async-resource lineage alone cannot prove server-side delay or command ownership.
limits.zh-CN: 长讨论混有不同版本与报告者负载；2026 年测试不是已确认复现。仅 async-resource 祖先不能证明数据库延迟或命令所有权。

first_step.en: Obtain a reproducing input and exact package/server versions before reusing the maintainer comparison.
first_step.zh-CN: 先取得能复现的输入及精确客户端／服务端版本，再决定是否复用维护者对照。

question.en: Does command shutdown wait on a live child, inherited pipes, or bookkeeping?
question.zh-CN: 命令关闭究竟在等子进程、被继承的 pipe，还是清理记账？

known.en: The captured issue body reports long command waits. The rendered page omits discussion despite a large comment count in the database, so current conclusions and repair status are unknown.
known.zh-CN: 所读正文报告长时间等待命令结束，但页面未返回讨论，而数据库记录大量评论；目前的结论与补丁状态未知。

patch.en: Unverified: full discussion and tracker history must be read before admitting this as an unpatched issue.
patch.zh-CN: 未核实：必须先读完整讨论和 tracker 历史，才能列为无补丁候选。

coroperf_addition.en: Join goroutine creation/execution to subprocess PID generations and descriptor ownership, then separate process exit, copy completion and shutdown wait.
coroperf_addition.zh-CN: 把 goroutine 创建／执行接到子进程 PID 代次与 fd 所有权，区分进程退出、复制结束与关闭等待。

required_evidence.en: Goroutine generations, child/descendant process generations, pipe holders, cancellation and reap events. Process/descriptor observers go beyond creation-stack stitching.
required_evidence.zh-CN: goroutine 代次、子／后代进程代次、pipe 持有者、取消和回收事件；进程／fd 观察超出创建栈拼接。

validation.en: Recover the exact failing regtest and command inputs; do not infer one common root cause for every flake in the tracker.
validation.zh-CN: 恢复精确失败的 regtest 与命令输入，不把 tracker 中所有偶发失败归成同一根因。

limits.en: Supplemental status check, outside the three primary candidates. No complete comment history or original runnable fixture is available in the reviewed record.
limits.zh-CN: 仅作补充核验，不计入三个主要候选；现有记录没有完整评论历史和原始可运行 fixture。

first_step.en: Read the missing discussion and locate an unresolved failing build first.
first_step.zh-CN: 先补齐讨论，找到仍未解决的具体失败构建。

reason.en: Open, but a maintainer already identifies a timeout/cancellation race and a keepalive workaround. It is a hypothesis-validation case, not a blank root-cause discovery case; the original application is incomplete.
reason.zh-CN: 仍 open，但维护者已指出 timeout／cancellation 竞争并给出 keepalive 缓解；适合验证假设，不能写成从零发现根因，且原应用不完整。

reason.en: Open, but the activity references repair commits and PR review. A Development box without a PR does not establish no patch.
reason.zh-CN: 仍 open，但活动中已有修复提交和 PR review；Development 未列 PR 不能证明没有补丁。

reason.en: The report already explains executor head-of-line blocking and supplies an application scheduler workaround and regression comparison. Earlier local capture timed out without saved target results.
reason.zh-CN: 报告已解释 executor 队头阻塞，并给出应用 scheduler 缓解与回归对照；早前本地采集超时，未保存目标结果。

reason.en: The report already gives the lost-demand/ABA interleaving, test counts and workaround. Useful for attribution validation, not a new root-cause claim.
reason.zh-CN: 报告已有 demand 丢失／ABA 交错分析、测试计数与缓解；可验证归属，不适合作为新发现根因。

reason.en: The report already explains the completion-token executor/strand mismatch and a debugger-forced ordering. Remaining work concerns validation or repair.
reason.zh-CN: 报告已解释 completion token 的 executor／strand 不匹配，并给出调试器强制交错；剩余工作是验证或修复。

reason.en: Still open, but a maintainer cannot reproduce on v2.0 and asks for a retest. Establish an affected build before root-cause work. Its async I/O task representation is not yet established as a coroutine.
reason.zh-CN: 仍 open，但维护者表示 v2.0 无法复现并请求重测；应先确认受影响构建，且尚未建立其 async I/O task 就是协程。

reason.en: The reporter supplies timeout clues and a terminate-on-timeout application workaround. No confirmed library repair is shown; this is not an issue with no existing result.
reason.zh-CN: 报告者已有 timeout 线索及超时后 terminate 的应用缓解；页面未展示已确认库修复，但不属于没有任何已有结果的 issue。

reason.en: Repair PR #8313 already exists. Its administrative closure does not make this an unpatched first-root-cause opportunity.
reason.zh-CN: 已有修复 PR #8313，虽因未获 issue 指派自动关闭，仍是已有补丁，不能作为我们的首次根因发现。

reason.en: The discussion already explains unsettled gather siblings and reports a locally tested fix; exclude from new unpatched root-cause targets.
reason.zh-CN: 上游已解释 gather 未收拢 sibling 的根因，并报告本地修复验证；不列为新的无 fix 根因候选。

reason.en: HTTPcore PRs #1113/#1116 address the original double-cancel case. A distinct fully-read cleanup gap remains discussed; the whole issue cannot be labeled as having no fix.
reason.zh-CN: 原 double-cancel 场景已有 HTTPcore PR #1113／#1116 与验证；另有 fully-read 清理缺口讨论，不能将整个 issue 宣称为没有 fix。

publication.note: Current popular-framework review update is awaiting Git publication.

synchronization.remote_fetch: Verified fetch of origin/main using the local HTTP proxy and GitHub SSH on port 443.

priority_note.en: Prioritize the two popular-framework leads below. Earlier Asio, Redis and mysql2 entries remain follow-ups; Go requires a status check. No new verified case or execution is claimed.
priority_note.zh-CN: 优先审阅下面两个热门框架候选；原 Asio、Redis、mysql2 条目保留为后续跟进，Go 先核验状态。本次未增加验证案例或执行结果。
